description: Lanka Securities (Private) Limited Vs Colombo Stock Exchange and Others Lanka Securities (Private) Limited Vs Colombo Stock Exchange and Others View More before Hon.Dr.D. F. H. Gunawardhana, J.
parties: Lanka Securities (Private) Limited Vs Colombo Stock Exchange and Others Lanka Securities (Private) Limited Vs Colombo Stock Exchange and Others View More
keywords: The Petitioner, a broker registered in the Colombo Stock Exchange, handled a CDS Account of one Mrs. Molamure; however, without her expressed authorisation, had acted and operated the account as a discretionary account and caused damages to Mrs. Molamure, who complained to the 1st Respondent; Panel of Inquiry’s findings were against the Petitioner for violation of Rules promulgated by the 1st Respondent in terms of Securities Exchange Commission Act, No. 36 of 1987, and directed compensation be paid by the Petitioner; On appeal, Dispute Resolution Committee affirmed decision; Petitioner challenged both decisions. Held – Appeal dismissed with costs as Petitioner found to have violated the said Rules.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
